purpose: Teach: くっつけ/談笑/オット/奥底/仇/ぶさ/里帰り/見いだす

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが手紙に切手をくっつけて下さった
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he used to stick stamps on his letters so carefully…
lines.style: Soft, faraway voice. Gentle inhale at the opening, as if calling back a memory. Slow, deliberate pace. Fingers moving through time, not hurrying. Slight tremor of affection on the image.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、ご友人と縁側で談笑されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes — and your grandfather used to laugh with his friends out on the veranda, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Warm, present-tense fondness in her voice. She's not looking back — she's there. Light, conversational rhythm. Soft affectionate lilt on 'dear,' the way she checks if he's still with her.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、私のオットとして力強くいて下さった
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, your father was strong for me — steadfast, the way a husband should be.
lines.style: Quiet certainty underneath. Voice steadies on 'strong.' Not boasting — describing a fact he still feels in his chest. Slow, measured. Trailing off slightly, as if the words are bigger than the breath.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、心の奥底に戦中の記憶を秘めてらしたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather carried the war's weight in his heart, didn't he, dear? Deep down where he kept the hard things.
lines.style: Gentle but clear-eyed. Not softer on the difficult truth — she names it plainly. Warm recognition underneath. Patient pace, as if she's been holding this truth for decades and knows he knows it too.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは人を仇と思わぬ方だった
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, your father never thought of people as enemies. Not once.
lines.style: Voice carries quiet admiration. Weighted on 'never' — a small, firm statement. Wistful but not sad. The remembering of something he witnessed and never took for granted. Gentle fade.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃の写真は「ぶさかわ」と仰ったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And you used to call those photos of him as a young man 'adorably ugly,' remember, dear?
lines.style: Light laugh underneath her words — affectionate teasing. Warm brightness on the playful image. Quick, knowing — she's catching him in a small tenderness he might not admit. Gentle, intimate tone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お盆に里帰りした事を懐かしむ
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, I miss how we'd go home to the countryside for Obon, all of us together.
lines.style: Voice softens on the memory. Long, slow breath behind the words — not rushing. Nostalgia that sits gently in his chest. Trailing off on the image of returning. Tender, almost to himself.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、孫の才能を見いだすのが早かったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather had such a gift for seeing the gifts in his grandchildren before anyone else did, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Warm, proud recognition. Voice curves upward gently on the compliment — she's naming something true and kind. Intimate, close as a whisper. Soft on the final 'dear' — a moment of connection, checking his heart.
